details.description: Marengo Embed 3.0 is TwelveLabs' multimodal embedding model, generating vector representations from video, image, audio, and text so content can be searched and retrieved by meaning rather than keywords. It combines visual, audio, and text analysis for a unified understanding of video content, including recognizing people, objects, and brand logos, and performing speech-based semantic search. It launched on Amazon Bedrock on October 29, 2025 as an asynchronous (StartAsyncInvoke) embedding model.
advantages: Generates a single embedding space across video, image, audio, and text for cross-modal search.
Identifies people, objects, and brand logos within video content.
Performs speech recognition and semantic audio understanding as part of its analysis.
Finds content by meaning rather than literal keyword matches, including across languages such as Spanish and Chinese.
disadvantages: TwelveLabs has since released Marengo 3.5, which adds embedding support for documents that 3.0 lacks.
use_cases: Semantic video and image search and retrieval
Identifying people, objects, and brand logos in video content
Speech-based search across audio and video content

sources.title: Marengo Embed 3.0 model card - Amazon Bedrock

notes: Catalog facts restrict this to image_input modality with a 500-token max input, which looks like it reflects only the image-embedding path of a model TwelveLabs documents as also taking video, audio, and text; kept the catalog's facts as-is.
